fusions.name: Wet Coat Shake
fusions.desc: Shakes the water from your coat in a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 6 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Soaked] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives a charge back.

fusions.name: Unhurried Clout
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Shrugged Off
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Buoyant Bulk
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
